headline: Congress hits pause for the holiday week—Senate returns Tuesday for judicial showdown, House meets in pro forma later this week.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate was not in session on Monday, September 21. The chamber stands adjourned and will reconvene on Tuesday afternoon.

onTheFloor.title: United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas
onTheFloor.status: cloture vote scheduled for 5:30 PM on Tuesday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Monday, September 21 and adjourned after just four minutes. The chamber introduced 20 public bills and 7 resolutions, with no votes taken. An announcement was made regarding a contempt certification for Leon D. Black's failure to comply with an Oversight and Government Reform Committee subpoena.
